1 context: which function the problem is in
2 file : line : column, then error / warning / note, then the message
3 your source line, with ^~~ under the exact spot
4 a fix-it hint: what the compiler thinks you meant (not always present)
Clang uses the same layout. MSVC writes file(line): error C2065: … instead.
